question: Why is the question asked by the great goddess considered difficult even for gods?
premises: The speaker expresses strong approval of the question.
The great goddess has asked the speaker.
The matter asked about is hard to obtain even for the gods.
inference: The question is praised because it concerns a truth rarely accessible, even to the gods.
plain_english: Well said, well said, O great goddess; you have asked me about something hard to obtain even for the gods.
